entities.name: Deogratias Muganwa Byabazaire

entities.summary: Deogratias Muganwa Byabazaire, was a Roman Catholic priest who served as Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Hoima, from 21 May 1990 until 8 February 2014.
